obs: Washington v. Seattle School District No. 1

"The legislation challenged in Lee did permit voluntary integration efforts, for it expressly exempted from its restrictions the assignment of a pupil in the manner requested or authorized by his parents or guardian. ... Thus, as the District Court in Lee noted, the statute denie[d] appointed officials the power to implement non-voluntary programs for the improvement of racial balance."
